propositions: rebar hardcodes comment ceiling at 32767 (WIKI_DESCRIPTION_LIMIT) but Jira Data Center's jira.text.field.character.limit is admin-configurable with range 0 to 2147483647, causing silent truncation when an administrator raises or removes the limit
comments longer than 32767 but shorter than an instance's configured limit are silently truncated, creating a data-loss window for operators who have raised the limit above stock default

the constant WIKI_DESCRIPTION_LIMIT is incorrectly attributed to Cloud comment limits in code comments when it actually derives from jira.text.field.character.limit (DC property shared across Description, Environment, Comments, and Text custom fields)

sanitize_comment reuses fit_outbound (the description fitter) creating a latent coupling that could cause catastrophic misapplication if description fitting changes (e.g., Cloud uses ADF-size-based truncation incompatible with character counts)

comment_max_chars must be configurable per instance, default to 32767 matching JRASERVER-28519 stock default, and decouple from description fitting to prevent silent retargeting of comments by future description fitter changes
